metadata.name: Candidate Public Facilities & Lower-Risk Assembly Sites - Vijayawada Corridor
metadata.provenance_note: Coordinates and facility names correspond to real civic/educational/medical complexes in the Vijayawada metropolitan corridor. Elevations are derived from open topographic survey records (SRTM 30m reference). Live shelter occupancy, structural capacity, and official evacuation facility declarations are NOT available from open telemetry; capacity is explicitly labelled as UNAVAILABLE / NOT SURVEYED in accordance with scientific honesty requirements.

properties.name: VR Siddhartha Engineering College Campus
properties.notes: Spacious elevated educational campus with wide multi-story buildings and multi-gate arterial access.

properties.name: Indira Gandhi Municipal Stadium Complex
properties.notes: Large open civic stadium with wide perimeter gates and central urban road connectivity.

properties.name: Government General Hospital & Medical College
properties.notes: Key tertiary medical hub with dedicated emergency access corridors and high-ground vantage.

properties.name: PB Siddhartha College of Arts & Science
properties.notes: Central institutional compound set back from river corridor behind natural topographic elevation.

properties.name: Gunadala Mary Matha Upper Ridge Grounds
properties.notes: Naturally elevated hill-flank grounds well above historical flood inundation levels.

properties.name: Andhra Loyola College Grounds & Complex
properties.notes: Extensive educational grounds directly fronting the national highway corridor.

properties.name: Acharya Nagarjuna University Southern Approach Grounds

properties.name: Gannavaram Highway Community Center Grounds

properties.name: Vaddeswaram South Bank High Ground Compound

properties.name: Satyanarayanapuram Municipal Civic Grounds
